editorial.headline: Wholesale Bags and Luggage: Open Nationally, Blocked for PMA in Bali
editorial.standfirst: This wholesale activity is nationally open to full foreign ownership, but a permanent Bali moratorium prevents PMA registration there today.
editorial.body:
This activity covers the wholesale trade of bags, wallets, suitcases, backpacks and comparable goods made from leather, imitation leather, textiles, plastic, rubber or other materials. Its commercial territory is broad but recognisable: handbags, shopping bags, school and sports bags, wallets, cosmetic cases, knife or sword sheaths, and camera cases all sit within the same wholesale remit. The defining point is distribution at wholesale level, rather than the making of those goods or their sale to the final customer.

It is available to businesses at every stated scale: Mikro, Kecil, Menengah and Besar. Nationally, the activity is classified as TERBUKA for PMA, with a foreign-ownership ceiling of 100%. In practical terms, the national position permits full foreign ownership for a company registering this wholesale activity.

Bali changes the answer decisively. A foreign investor cannot register this activity as PMA in Bali today. At the Besar scale, OSS assesses every scope within the activity as Rendah or Menengah-Rendah risk; Bali’s moratorium therefore blocks the registration. The restriction is not a partial foreign-equity cap: it is a block on PMA registration in the province.

That Bali position follows a permanent, island-wide provincial moratorium on PMA registration for low- and medium-low-risk activities, recorded here as taking effect in May 2026. The national opening remains real, but it does not override the Bali-specific block. For founders, the honest reading is straightforward: this is a fully foreign-open wholesale activity at national level, yet unavailable for PMA registration in Bali under the stated risk-based moratorium.
editorial.pullQuote: Nationally open to 100% foreign ownership, this activity is nevertheless unavailable for PMA registration in Bali today.
